sentences.en: Parvati's mother never allowed her to have slumber parties.
sentences.zh: 帕尔瓦蒂的母亲从不允许她参加睡衣派对。

sentences.en: Parvati longed to have a slumber party with her friends from school.
sentences.zh: 帕尔瓦蒂渴望和学校里的朋友们一起参加睡衣派对。

sentences.en: He fell into a slumber inadvertently.
sentences.zh: 他不经意间陷入了沉睡。

senses.zh: 睡眠；麻木状态；静止状态
